ctx.x: Yeah, uh-huh. See now, as we were traveling, you see, and we got -- finally got to Philadelphia, he stopped at a place -- Miss Edwina Sutton's place down in Philadelphia somewhere on -- think it was North Philadelphia where she was. And she had a big picture of Mr. Buddy Bradley, you know, because her husband was in import and export, you see. He traveled on the seas, you see, and he

was a fan of Buddy Bradley's, you know, and he liked Buddy Bradley, and he had this picture; it was like a portrait; it was in the living room, and she liked us. So Mr. Robey had her to -- (inaudible) like as a guardian. She would look after us children while he would -- he'd like go -- he went over to New York with Obi Walker somewhere, you know, and he got him some fights or something, you know.

Then he came back, see. He came back. So we stayed in Philadelphia with this lady for about two and a half years, because we were getting older, see. You had to be 18 years old in order to appear on the stage then. So --
